title: Private Newport Mansions Day Trip from Boston
includes: Flexible itinerary customization within the included 8.5-hour service period
Private vehicle reserved exclusively for your group
Pickup and return to the confirmed Boston location
Up to 8 hours 30 minutes of service
Transportation between the scheduled Newport stops
Private round-trip transportation between Boston and Newport
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Vehicles are not wheelchair-lift equipped. Foldable wheelchairs, compact mobility devices, and strollers may be accommodated when they fit safely in the selected vehicle. Passengers must be able to transfer into a standard vehicle seat. Please contact the operator before booking to confirm available storage space. Accessibility at mansions and optional Newport stops varies by location. Child seats are available by advance request for an additional fee.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a private, customizable day trip from Boston to Newport in a comfortable vehicle reserved for your group. This is private transportation with flexible sightseeing stops; the chauffeur does not provide guided commentary.

Visit one, two, or up to three Newport mansions based on your tickets, entry times, attraction hours, and preferred pace. Most guests visit two mansions, stop for lunch, then choose a third mansion or another Newport attraction.

When time allows, options may include downtown Newport, Ocean Drive, or a brief Cliff Walk stop. Your chauffeur handles transportation between stops, so your group can relax without navigating traffic or parking.

All customization must fit within the included 8.5-hour service period and is subject to traffic, weather, attraction hours, and ticket times. To stay on schedule, the return to Boston should begin around 4:00 PM.

Mansion tickets and lunch are not included.
